_comment: Shot list for deploy/make_reel.py. Two shots per input mode, so the reel
shows each way of handing the model regions twice on different pictures
and nobody has to take a single lucky frame on trust.
Photo credits and licences are in credits.json, beside this file.
conf 0 = the mode's own default (see MODES in deploy/make_reel.py).

shots.note: man riding bicycle — the cleanest box-input shot

person riding horse; also the browser demo's first sample. Two edges: the 497-class detector finds only three regions here, and the third relation it ranks is between the rider's shirt and the horse behind it
cat sitting on laptop — masks separate cat from desk clutter

two edges only: the ranking's next two are true but hang off 'oilrig', which is what the 4,585-class vocabulary calls the scaffolding behind the rider. A wrong object name is the detector's, not the relation model's, but a viewer cannot tell that from a video
no class names anywhere: watching/holding between unnamed masks
holding, with the racket segmented but never named
